summary: Sometimes the difference between almost having the opportunity and actually having it is one unglamorous requirement you have been putting off because the exciting part already feels done.
body: Sometimes the difference between almost having the opportunity and actually having it is one unglamorous requirement you have been putting off because the exciting part already feels done. When the Sun sextiles Saturn, recognition can become more concrete through a signature, documented result, completed condition, formal commitment, or responsibility you are finally ready to accept. The last administrative step may seem small compared with everything it took to reach this point, but it is often the piece that turns encouragement into something you can rely on. Finish what makes the opportunity official so the work you already did comes with the status, authority, or commitment it was supposed to earn.
